name: remote-setting-changes-are-slash-commands
description: In remote mode Cycle Model types /model with the new alias, Cycle Effort types /effort with the new level, and New Session types /clear, each submitted with Enter. No harness of PowerUp's own is touched.
reason: PowerUp does not own the remote session, so it can only change its settings the way a person at the keyboard would: with slash commands. They are always submitted, whatever the auto-submit setting says, because a half-typed /model line does nothing.
source: DESIGN.md v1.8 remote mode; AppState.cycleModel / cycleEffort / newSession (remote branches)

script.reason: The default model is not in the cycle, so the first alias is next.
The default effort is not in the cycle, so the first level is next. Remote mode skips the harness's effort capability: the remote CLI decides.
A new session in remote mode clears the conversation the remote session holds.
